title: Quicklaunch passes %u to Firefox incorrectly
line: Quicklaunch's right-click actions like Firefox's "New Private Window" now run the right action without a stray literal %u.
explanation: Quicklaunch stored each jump-list action's raw Exec line and ran it with CommandLauncherJob, which runs a command as is, so field codes like %u reached the app literally and Firefox opened file:///home/<user>/%u. On master it is worse: since the 2026-11-01 linting commit the menu's click handler captures the loop variable, so every entry runs the menu's last action (Firefox's "New Private Window" opens the Profile Manager). The jump list now stores the action's key, and the click looks the action up in the desktop file and starts it with KIO::ApplicationLauncherJob (as Kickoff and the Task Manager do), which expands field codes; the loop variable is const so each entry keeps its own action.

commits.message:
applets/quicklaunch: expand field codes in jump-list actions

Jump-list actions ran their Exec line with CommandLauncherJob, which
leaves field codes like %u in place, and every entry ran the last one in
the menu. Start the chosen action with ApplicationLauncherJob instead.

BUG: 528653

media.caption: Master, Firefox-like launcher (actions New Window, New Private Window, Profile Manager): New Private Window runs the last action instead (--ProfileManager)
With the fix: New Private Window runs --private-window, with no %u
Master, launcher whose last action is New Private Window: it runs with a literal %u argument, the reported bug
With the fix: --private-window only, %u expanded away
Master: clicking New Private Window in the launcher's menu logs --ProfileManager
With the fix: the same click logs --private-window
